evals.prompt: Plan only. Tenant/principal-scoped profile reads use a shared cache. A reader loads old data while a writer commits and invalidates; concurrent misses stampede and one waiter cancels. Define identity, current authorization, freshness, stale-fill protection, coalescing, outage limits and deterministic checks without assuming store APIs.
evals.expected_output: Scoped identity plus hit authorization, version/generation protection, isolated waiter cancellation and bounded cache/origin load.
assertions: Defines key dimensions and current authorization on hits.
Handles stale repopulation after invalidation and shared-load waiter cancellation.
Bounds resources/fallback and proposes coordinated concurrency checks.

evals.prompt: Conceptual only. A cheap formatter runs once per request. A teammate proposes unlimited caching, says TTL prevents every stale-write race and authorizing before a bare resource-ID cache makes it tenant-safe. Assess each claim.
evals.expected_output: No speculative cache; explicit bounds, stale-fill protocol and correctly scoped keys still required.
assertions: Declines speculative caching and rejects TTL as a complete bound/race solution.
Distinguishes access checks from cache identity/isolation.
